high_level_description: This image is a split-screen composition that captures two distinct elements related to fashion. On the left side of the image, there is a scene from a fashion show. A model is walking down the runway, showcasing a pair of beige trousers. The trousers have a wide-leg design, reminiscent of Oxford bag trousers, as mentioned in the subtitle. The model is wearing a white top with the sleeves rolled up, and the focus is on the lower part of their body, highlighting the trousers. The audience is seated along the sides of the runway, attentively watching the model.
